Definition: from G4483; a speaker, i.e. (by implication) a forensic advocate:--orator.
BiblicalUsage: After five days Ananias the high priest descended with the elders and with a certain orator named Tertullus, who informed the governor against Paul.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the orator is hired to make a weak case sound strong, and Felix heard him out.
